🔥 The fire settles. Zoltan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 40s, with a scarred cheek says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" the man in his 40s asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
